content.text: I fixed two off-by-one errors in `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (3 tests). In `_cell_lines`, the wrap loop used `len(line) > width - 1`, so text was wrapped one character too early. In `_align`, the padding was computed as `width - len(text) - 1`, so every cell came out one space short. Both now use the true column width.
